title: Equilibrium Point
description:
[Source: GFG Classic]
Given an array A of n positive numbers. The task is to find the first equilibrium point in an array. An equilibrium point is an index (1-based) such that the sum of elements before it equals the sum of elements after it.

Input Format:
First line: n
Second line: n space-separated integers

Output Format:
1-based index of equilibrium point or -1
